name: Shoujo wa Manatsu ni Kaigan de
source:
Yuzuki and Shugo both worked at a beach house one summer vacation.
Yuzuki secretly yearned for Shugo and her heart was pounding at the chance, but then junior Aya appeared and took the summer in an unexpected direction...
a threesome of two girls and one boy.
How did this happen? It's all the fault of the hot summer sun...
Enjoy three lovers as they explore a dangerous relationship. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE077791.html]English DLSite[/url]]
translation:
某年暑假，柚月和守护一起在海滨小屋打工。
柚月暗暗渴望着守护，心潮澎湃，但学弟绫的出现却把这个夏天带向了意想不到的方向……
两个女孩和一个男孩组成的三人关系，就这样开始了。
这一切究竟是怎么发生的？或许都是炎炎夏日惹的祸……
享受三名恋人共同探索危险关系的过程。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE077791.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
